metadata.title: IEPL/IPLC and IP Transit Provider, Asia Pacific | Vocom
metadata.description: Private leased circuits (IEPL/IPLC), IP transit, local loop and wholesale voice termination across the Pacific. 99.9% uptime, 100+ regions. Talk to sales.

attributes.text: Cross-Pacific Connectivity: IEPL/IPLC, IP Transit & Voice
Global internet with IP transit and Layer 2 Ethernet, plus IEPL/IPLC private lines, MPLS-VPN, Anti-DDoS and wholesale voice termination, engineered per carrier across the Pacific and beyond.
Direct interconnects across Asia, the Americas and Europe
Send your traffic profile, get sized by an engineer, and go live:
Target destinations and volume for voice, or your current traffic mix for data and MPLS.
We respond with real ASR, ACD and latency, not just a rate card.
An owned backbone, not resold transport:
Owned MPLS/VPLS backbone with direct connectivity into AWS, Azure and Microsoft.
Local, national and international interconnects through legacy TDM and modern VoIP/NGN.
Tier-1 sourced fiber optic cable and 20+ global PoPs and IDCs keep the network close to every route.
Learn More About Our Fiber Solutions
Designed to Meet Your Communications Needs
Private leased circuits across the Pacific and beyond, for secure point-to-point data transfer.
Local access into Vocom’s PoPs for the last mile of a private circuit.
Tier-1 sourced outside-plant and indoor fiber optic cable, delivered build-to-order.
Local peering blended with global BGP across 20+ PoPs, including a dedicated China route by carrier.
An owned MPLS/VPLS backbone with direct cloud connectivity and flexible routing policy.
Regional scrubbing centers across Asia and the US/EU, always on, not on-demand only.
Wholesale IDD termination and carrier-grade SMS routing on direct NNI relationships.
eSIM at ezsim.com, T-Mobile MVNO service, and Supermicro AI servers inside Vocom’s own IDCs.
Vocom’s earliest business line is still one of its strongest: wholesale IDD termination and SMS routing built on direct interconnects, not resold capacity.
✓ Wholesale IDD termination across global destinations
✓ Direct NNI relationships, not aggregated resale

attributes.text: IP Transit and DIA, Global Route

Local peering blended with global BGP across 20+ regions, including the USA, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Singapore, Philippines, Japan, UAE, Malaysia, China Mainland, Thailand, South Korea, Cambodia, India, Australia, UK, Brazil and Mexico.

children.name: IP Transit and DIA, China Route

attributes.text: IP Transit and DIA, China Route
China connectivity engineered per carrier: China Telecom, China Unicom and China Mobile, with a tunable mix route blending CT, CU, CM and global routes to match each customer’s traffic profile.
An owned MPLS/VPLS backbone, not resold transport, with direct connectivity into AWS, Azure and Microsoft, and flexible traffic control policy.
Regional scrubbing centers across Asia and the US/EU, always on, not on-demand only, paired with the same NOC that runs IP transit and MPLS.
✓ Equipment shelf installation and integrated cabling
✓ Equipment debugging, operation and maintenance monitoring, and troubleshooting

Tier-1 sourced outside-plant and indoor fiber optic products across the full range: 288 to 1728 strand ribbon and loose tube cable, direct burial, in-duct, aerial, ADSS and drop cable, from OM3-5 multimode to OS2 stranded single-mode. Delivery lead time runs 6 to 8 weeks upon PO, up to 10 weeks for custom builds.

attributes.$control__testimonial1: Chunghwa Telecom, China Telecom, China Unicom and China Mobile
attributes.$control__testimonial2: Equinix, HGC, HKIX, Cogent, Verizon and NTT
attributes.$control__testimonial3: PLDT, Arelion, StarHub Business, RETN and e&

attributes.$control__question: What regions do you serve?
attributes.$control__answer: VOCOM's core services are concentrated in cross-Pacific destinations, with China, Hong Kong and Taiwan carrying particular emphasis, plus active routes into India, Australia, the Middle East, Europe and the Americas across 20+ PoPs and IDCs.

attributes.$control__question: Do you offer a dedicated China route?
attributes.$control__answer: Yes. China connectivity is engineered per carrier rather than as a single blended feed, across China Telecom, China Unicom and China Mobile, with a tunable mix route to match each customer's traffic profile.

attributes.$control__question: What support do you offer?
attributes.$control__answer: The same NOC that runs IP transit and MPLS also watches Anti-DDoS and voice routes, 24/7, with a dedicated system integration team for on-site deployments.

attributes.$control__question: Do you handle the physical deployment too?
attributes.$control__answer: Yes. A dedicated project management and technical team handles consulting, equipment procurement, logistics, installation, cabling, debugging and troubleshooting for overseas builds, end to end.

attributes.$control__question: How long has Vocom been in telecommunications?
attributes.$control__answer: Vocom was founded in 1998, with a focus on cross-Pacific and Asia-Pacific connectivity.

attributes.$control__question: Do you offer IEPL and IPLC private circuits?
attributes.$control__answer: Yes. Vocom provides IEPL and IPLC private leased circuits on cross-Pacific and Asia-Pacific routes, including India to Australia and other APAC point-to-point lanes, sized from sub-1 Gbps access links up to 10 Gbps and above. Contact us with your endpoints and bandwidth requirement.

attributes.$control__question: Do you provide IP transit and dark fiber in Asia-Pacific?
attributes.$control__answer: Yes. Alongside private circuits, Vocom provides IP transit, dark fiber and data center connectivity across the region. Contact us to discuss coverage for your locations.

attributes.$control__question: How do I contact sales?
attributes.$control__answer: Use the contact page to reach the team. Tell us what you need and where, and we will respond with next steps.

attributes.$control__question: What bandwidth options are available for IEPL/IPLC circuits?
attributes.$control__answer: IEPL and IPLC circuits are sized to the traffic profile you send us, from sub-1 Gbps access links up to 10 Gbps and above for high-capacity point-to-point routes such as India to Australia. Send your two endpoints and the bandwidth you need and we will return a sized quote.

attributes.text: Tell us your route requirements, we will size the connection before you commit to anything.
